source: Aseprite Trial 1.3.18.6 (AppImage, observed black box) under its own Xvfb 1600x1000, isolated HOME, screen_scale 2, 400 % zoom (8 screen px per cell), centre of each cell. Driven by docs/PixelArt/ferramentas/trial_elipse_grelha.py (xdotool), written by trial_fixture_elipse.py. Aseprite source never read. Measured 2026-10-27.
method: Elliptical Marquee (Shift+M) in Add mode (bar button, never Shift) on a 160x100 opaque red sprite: many boxes per page, shelf-packed with 4 free cells between them (the transform handles grab presses closer than that), press at the CENTRE of the box corner cell "at" and release at the centre of the opposite corner (w-1, h-1 further); mask read by Edit>Fill #FF00FF + Esc + screenshot; nothing outside the boxes may be selected (checked per page). "rows"[j] = [x0, x1] selected in row j, relative to the box (null = empty row).
command: PH2D_TRIAL_DISPLAY=:84 python3 -I trial_elipse_grelha.py <dir> tl br ; ... <dir2> tl --caixas <lista.json> (sides 26..64 x 3 odd heights each; even widths 66..150 and even heights 26..96 with one small odd other side) ; python3 -I trial_fixture_elipse.py <dir>/grelha.json <dir2>/grelha.json <dir3>/grelha.json <this file>
checks: drag direction: the 1..24 grid was measured pressing top-left AND bottom-right, 576/576 identical (and tl/br/tr/bl on 16 boxes); position: 5 boxes at 4 different (x, y) each, identical; zoom: the 112 boxes of oracle_trial_selection.json (800 %) are reproduced exactly here.
law_observed: odd side, or even side in {4, 8, 12, 22}: Zingl plotEllipseRect on that axis; any other even side n: Zingl with n+1 on that axis, then the two lines next to the middle one dropped and the middle one doubled (rows and columns independently). 715/715.
